definitions.ask: Should a Cancelled ([-]) close archive the thread, like Done?
definitions.why: The request's own "out of sight" parenthetical; a done-only arm stays cheap to add later.

choices.label: A cancelled last task also drains its thread; out of sight means out of the Inbox.
Only [x]/[X] closes archive; a [-] close leaves the thread in the Inbox.

definitions.ask: What should the Gmail receipt label be named?
definitions.why: Reads as an explanation in the Gmail sidebar, not just an action log.

choices.label: bob/closed -- says why the thread left the Inbox.

definitions.ask: What default should the archive_max burst breaker use?
definitions.why: Invisible in normal weeks, still pauses a real bulk-close incident.

choices.label: archive_max 10, about two weeks of current volume.
archive_max 5 for the first month, raised later.

definitions.ask: Close bead bob-cli-i4 (opt-in unlabel of bob after pull) as superseded by this design?
definitions.why: i4 strips the label this feature reads as live consent; built as specified they conflict.

choices.label: Closes with a note pointing here; a nested-label scheme can still serve its phone-queue goal.
Stays open but frozen; nobody builds it until the label-consent conflict is re-decided.

definitions.ask: Record the accepted design as the new decisions-web strand closing-a-task-archives-its-bob-mail-once?
definitions.requested: I would like to make it so the `bob gmail sync` command starts archiving emails in gmail automatically when appropriate. Can you help me implement this?
